one_line_description.value: Consensus is an AI academic search engine for peer-reviewed literature, positioned as a research OS for finding, organizing, and analyzing science.
one_line_description.quote: Consensus is an AI academic search engine for peer-reviewed literature—your research OS for finding, organizing, and analyzing science 10x faster.

has_public_api.quote: The Consensus API lets you search 400+ million scholarly articles, including 350 million peer-reviewed research papers, over a single REST endpoint.

api_type.quote: REST, with samples in cURL, Python, JavaScript, Go, PHP, Ruby and Java

api_breadth.value: Small REST surface (~5 endpoint groups: search, Threads, full text, citations, references); read-oriented
api_breadth.quote: `GET /v1/papers/full_text`, `GET /v1beta/papers/citations`, and `GET /v1beta/papers/references` each allow one request per second on every plan, Enterprise included.

docs_url.quote: Search over 400 million scholarly articles, including 350 million peer-reviewed research papers, with the Consensus REST API.

auth_methods.quote: `query` is the only required parameter, and the key goes in the `x-api-key` header.

access_model.quote: The API is self-serve on every Consensus plan.

access_notes.value: Self-serve on all plans; Free provides 30 calls/month and 20 papers/request, paid plans raise call/page limits and unlock features like pagination and full text; Enterprise gets custom limits. API keys are created directly in the API & MCP Dashboard.
access_notes.quote: The API is self-serve on every Consensus plan. Your plan sets how many calls you get each month, how many papers each request can return, and which features you can use.

official_mcp_server.quote: claude mcp add --transport http consensus https://mcp.consensus.app/mcp

rate_limits.value: 1 request/second per self-serve account; excess returns 429 with retry-after; Thread polling 3/sec; full-text, citations, and references 1/sec; Enterprise custom limits
rate_limits.quote: Every self-serve plan allows one request per second per account. A faster request returns `429` with a `retry-after` header; wait that long and retry. Enterprise accounts can have custom limits.

api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.value: URL path versioning (v1 / v1beta); legacy /v1/quick_search is deprecated and scheduled for removal on 2027-02-07
api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.quote: Use this instead of the legacy `/v1/quick_search` endpoint, which is deprecated and will be removed on 2027-02-07.

verdict_reason: Consensus documents a public REST API that is self-serve on every plan, including a free plan with 30 calls/month, and API keys are created directly in the dashboard. Authentication is a simple x-api-key header, and the API covers search, Threads, full text, and citation/reference lookups. The main constraints are a 1 request/second rate limit and modest free quota, but no sales contact or app review is required.
open_questions: Input hint says 'OAuth requested', but the REST API docs only document an x-api-key header; OAuth sign-in is documented only for the hosted MCP server. Confirm whether OAuth is available for the REST API.
No official vendor-maintained SDKs are documented; docs show raw cURL/Python/JavaScript/Go/PHP/Ruby/Java samples only, so sdk_languages is marked not_found.
No webhook/event-callback or sandbox/test-environment documentation was found in the evidence; those fields are set false with low confidence.
No OAuth scopes/permissions are documented for the REST API; oauth_scopes_documented is set false with low confidence.
No community MCP servers were found in the GitHub or MCP registry evidence.
